title: Result
description: One result line in a PocketEval JSONL results file.

item_id.description: Matches item_id in the corresponding TaskItem.

item_version.description: Version of the task item used in this run.

run_index.description: Zero-based index of this run within a variance trial.

timestamp.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp when inference started.

model_id.description: Model identifier as reported by the runtime.

model_version.description: Specific model version or checkpoint string.

os_version.description: Operating system version string of the device.

raw_output.description: Verbatim text produced by the model. Always present, never omitted.

parsed_output.description: Structured object parsed from raw_output, or null if parsing failed.

schema_valid.description: True if parsed_output validates against the task expected schema.

correct_strict.description: True if the answer is exactly correct after normalisation.

correct_lenient.description: True if the answer is correct under lenient matching rules.

time_to_first_token_ms.description: Milliseconds from prompt submission to first token. Null if not captured.

total_latency_ms.description: Milliseconds from prompt submission to last token. Null if not captured.

decode_tokens_per_sec.description: Decode throughput in tokens per second. Null if not captured.

peak_memory_mb.description: Peak resident memory in megabytes during inference. Null if not captured.

thermal_state.description: Thermal state reported by the OS at end of inference, e.g. nominal/fair/serious/critical.

battery_delta_pct.description: Change in battery percentage during inference (negative means drain). Null if not captured.
